title: Crispy Double Italian Sausage Parm Hero
ingredients: 1 lb sweet and/or hot Italian sausages, casings removed
2 long crusty Italian hero/sub rolls, split lengthwise
6 slices low-moisture mozzarella or provolone cheese
2 cloves garlic + 2 tbsp melted garlic-herb butter (for toasting the roll)
Fresh basil leaves and dried oregano
instructions: Press the uncased Italian sausage meat into two long flat patties the exact length of your hero rolls (or butterfly whole links).
Sear the sausage patties in a hot cast-iron skillet for 4–5 minutes per side until deeply browned and crisp.
Brush the split hero rolls with garlic butter and toast under the broiler for 2 minutes.
Layer two stacked sausage patties into each roll with hot marinara sauce, mozzarella, and Parmigiano-Reggiano. Broil 2–3 minutes until the cheese is blistered and molten; top with fresh basil.
